PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?capability ?label
WHERE {
  sdk:org-001 sdk:hasProcessCapability ?capability .
  ?capability rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?label), "machining"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?cap ?label
WHERE {
  VALUES ?cap {
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/SteelProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/CastSteelProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AlloySteelProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/SuperAlloyProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/BlueTempSteelProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/StainlessSteelProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/LowAlloySteelLeadProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/ExoticMaterialProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AlloyProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/MetalProcessingCapability>
  }
  ?cap rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(lcase(?label), "steel")) .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?descriptionText WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
              rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?label), "fabrication"))
  ?manufacturer iof-core:describedBy ?desc .
  ?desc iof-scro:hasTextValue ?descriptionText .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?site ?zip WHERE {
  ?site a sdk:GeospatialLocation ;
        sdk:hasPostalAddress ?addr .
  ?addr iof-scro:hasTextValue ?addrText .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(lcase(str(?addrText)), "suite")) .
  ?site sdk:hasZIPcode ?zipnode .
  ?zipnode sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zip .
}
ORDER BY ?site

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?materialCapability
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
               rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?name), "metal"))
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?materialCapability .
  VALUES ?materialCapability {
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/MetalProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/JoiningCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/SheetMetalProcessingProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/SuperAlloyProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AdditiveManufacturingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/ExoticMaterialProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/VaporizedMetalCoatingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AlloyProcessingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/PowderMetalFormingCapability>
    <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/NADCAP>
  }
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?zip WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?name), "casting"))
  ?org sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasZIPcode ?zipnode .
  ?zipnode sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zip .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manuf) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
         sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?cityLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manuf) AS ?manufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manuf rdf:type iof-core:Manufacturer ;
         sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?cityLabel
ORDER BY ?cityLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?industry ?industryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?ManufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry .
  ?industry a sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry .
  OPTIONAL { ?industry rdfs:label ?industryLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?industry ?industryLabel
ORDER BY ?industryLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (AVG(?emp) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
     sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?emp .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (SUM(?e) AS ?totalEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?emp .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State ;
         rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?emp), ",", "")) AS ?e)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?product) AS ?productCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel .
  ?manufacturer sdk:manufactures ?product .
  ?product a iof-core:MaterialProduct .
}
GROUP BY ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?stateName
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateName), "texas"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?name
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry sdk:industry-001 .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry sdk:industry-002 .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel .
  ?org sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label "Phoenix" .
  ?city a sdk:City .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label "Arizona" .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?org sdk:hasCertificate ?cert . }
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?bronzeCap .
  ?bronzeCap a sdk:BronzeProcessingCapability .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?steelCap .
  ?steelCap a sdk:SteelProcessingCapability .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manuf ?name
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manuf rdfs:label ?name . }
  ?manuf sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat .
  FILTER(xsd:float(?lat) > 45.0)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
              sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?lon .
  FILTER(?lon < 100.0)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manuf ?manufLabel ?employees
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
         rdfs:label ?manufLabel ;
         sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
         sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employees .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateLabel), "ohio")) .
}
ORDER BY ASC(xsd:integer(?employees))
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manuf) AS ?manufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manuf sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?city ?cityLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city a sdk:City .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?city ?cityLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>

SELECT ?product (COUNT(DISTINCT ?man) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:manufactures ?product .
  ?product a iof-core:MaterialProduct .
}
GROUP BY ?product
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers) ?product
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?name ?lat WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name .
}
ORDER BY DESC(?lat)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site a sdk:GeospatialLocation .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city a sdk:City .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?stateLabel), "california"))
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?name
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site a sdk:GeospatialLocation .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat .
  FILTER(?lat > 40.0)
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name . }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?name
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?lon .
  FILTER(?lon < 90.0)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?name
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name . }
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat ;
          sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?long .
  FILTER (?lat = "33.364638"^^xsd:float && ?long = "-111.931604"^^xsd:float)
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manuf) AS ?manufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manuf sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel. }
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER (REGEX(?stateLabel, "^New "))
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel ?cityLabel ?procCapLabel ?matCapLabel
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?orgLabel ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
  FILTER (str(?cityLabel) = "New York")
  OPTIONAL {
     ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?procCap .
     ?procCap rdfs:label ?procCapLabel .
     ?procCap a ?procCapType .
     VALUES ?procCapType {
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/NylonProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AcetalProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/NickelProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/PlasticProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/ZytelProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AcrylicProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/GlassProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/MetalProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/BabbitProcessingCapability>
     }
  }
  OPTIONAL {
     ?org sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?matCap .
     ?matCap rdfs:label ?matCapLabel .
     ?matCap a ?matCapType .
     VALUES ?matCapType {
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/NylonProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AcetalProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/NickelProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/PlasticProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/ZytelProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/AcrylicProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/GlassProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/MetalProcessingCapability>
        <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/BabbitProcessingCapability>
     }
  }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?bucket (COUNT(DISTINCT ?company) AS ?companyCount)
WHERE {
  ?company a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
           sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employees .
  FILTER (xsd:integer(?employees) > 250)
  BIND (">250" AS ?bucket)
}
GROUP BY ?bucket
ORDER BY ?bucket

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manLabel ?cap ?capLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
               rdfs:label ?manLabel ;
               sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?capClass .
  FILTER (?capClass IN (
    sdk:CoatingCapability,
    sdk:VaporizedMetalCoatingCapability,
    sdk:MechanicalCoatingCapability,
    sdk:ChemicalCoatingCapability,
    sdk:ThermalCoatingCapability,
    sdk:PowderCoatingCapability,
    sdk:PhosphateCoatingCapability
  ))
  ?cap rdfs:label ?capLabel .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (AVG(?numEmps) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?manuf a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
          sdk:manufactures ?prod ;
          sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
          sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numEmps .
  ?prod rdfs:label ?prodLabel .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?prodLabel), "pipe"))
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?naics ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?org sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naics .
  ?org sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?naics ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?naics ?manufacturerCount DESC
LIMIT 5

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?cap ?type ?label
WHERE {
  VALUES ?type {
    sdk:ExoticMaterialProcessingCapability
    sdk:InvarProcessingCapability
    sdk:AcrylicProcessingCapability
    sdk:DelrinProcessingCapability
    sdk:PlexiglasProcessingCapability
    sdk:CTFEProcessingCapability
    sdk:TorlonProcessingCapability
    sdk:SiliconeProcessingCapability
  }
  ?cap a ?type .
  OPTIONAL { ?cap rdfs:label ?label . }
}

  FILTER(regex(?pcLabel, "ing$", "i"))
}
